title: Add production hardening baseline

context.summary: Add the minimum production-readiness baseline for a non-demo MVP.
context.background: The local MVP runs, but external use needs CI, release image path, migration safety guidance, secret handling, rate limits and observability conventions.

in: Add CI workflow for lint, typecheck, tests, task validation and dry-run acceptance.
Document migration backup/rollback strategy for MVP deployments.
Document secret management expectations and unsafe defaults.
Add API rate-limit or request guard baseline where appropriate.
Add structured logging/observability guidance for API and worker operations.
out: Replace local Docker Compose with hosted infrastructure.

acceptance_criteria: CI can run the repository verification commands on pull requests or pushes.
Release image build path is documented and reproducible.
Secret handling guidance identifies required production overrides.
API has a basic request protection/rate-limit stance or a documented explicit deferral.
Logs remain structured and useful for API and worker diagnosis.

manual_checks: Confirm CI does not require private secrets for default checks.
Confirm production docs clearly distinguish demo defaults from production settings.

risks: CI can become too slow if it tries to run every live provider scenario by default.
Production hardening can sprawl; keep this task to the MVP baseline.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
